bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
r=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot
w="$r/.worktrees/room-userbot-joined-dialog-4de814a"
b="$HOME/.local/state/gace-userbot-joined-dialog-rollback-20261113"
u=gace-userbot-verify.service
test "$(git -C "$w" rev-parse HEAD)" = 4de814af43115a7347b997de2636fd942218dc51 || exit 70
test ! -e "$b" || exit 71
test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u")" = active || exit 72
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 73
mkdir -m 700 -p "$b"
cp -p "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$b/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
rollback() {
 echo RESIDENT_IPC_ROLLBACK
 cp -p "$b/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
 systemctl --user restart "$u" || :
}
trap rollback ERR
install -m 600 "$w/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py" "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py.new"
mv -f "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py.new" "$r/scripts/userbot_resident_ipc.py"
before=$(systemctl --user show "$u" -p MainPID --value)
systemctl --user restart "$u" || exit 74
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
 if test "$(systemctl --user is-active "$u" || :)" = active && test -S "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock"; then
  if "$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health; then break; fi
 fi
 sleep 1
done
"$r/deploy/.userbot-venv/bin/python" -B "$r/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" health || exit 75
test "$(systemctl --user show "$u" -p MainPID --value)" != "$before" || exit 76
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.session")" = 600 || exit 77
test "$(stat -c %a "$r/deploy/secrets/userbot_verify.sock")" = 600 || exit 78
test "$(systemctl --user is-enabled "$u")" = enabled || exit 79
test "$(docker inspect deploy-gaybbs-1 --format '{{.State.Running}}')" = true || exit 80
trap - ERR
echo JOINED_DIALOG_RESOLUTION_RUNTIME_PASS
echo USERBOT_SESSION_PRESERVED=YES
echo GAYBBS_PRESERVED=YES
